tool_input.command:
$h=@{'User-Agent'='dsh-agent'}
$t=(Invoke-WebRequest 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fish-under-sea/dsh-our-free-model-fish/main/README.md' -Headers $h -TimeoutSec 25 -UseBasicParsing).Content
$lines = $t -split "`n"
Write-Output '--- matches: 分组 / 计价 / 渠道模型 / FISH / devDependencies / 本仓库 ---'
for ($i=0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { if ($lines[$i] -match '分组|计价|隐藏|FISH|devDependencies|本仓库|Fish-under-sea') { Write-Output ("{0}: {1}" -f ($i+1), $lines[$i].Trim()) } }
Write-Output ''
Write-Output '=== fork repo root files ==='
(Invoke-RestMethod 'https://api.github.com/repos/Fish-under-sea/dsh-our-free-model-fish/contents/' -Headers $h -TimeoutSec 25) | Select-Object name,type | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120
tool_input.description: Find fork-specific documentation and repo layout
